seo.description: Visit Raissouni Palace in Asilah: early 20th-century Hispano-Moorish architecture, cultural events and workshops in the medina area.
seo.og_description: Visit Raissouni Palace in Asilah: early 20th-century Hispano-Moorish architecture, cultural events and workshops in the medina area.

name: Palacio Raissouni
hero_subtitle: Un palacio hispano-morisco de principios del siglo XX con eventos culturales en Asilah.

overview.title: Un palacio para la cultura
overview.p1: El Palacio Raissouni refleja la historia de principios del siglo XX y el estilo hispano-morisco.
overview.p2: Consulta localmente si está abierto durante tu estancia.
overview.p3: Combínalo con la medina artística y Borj Al-Kamra.

1.title: Best during programmes
1.desc: Concerts, workshops or open days give the richest visit.

2.title: Architecture stop
2.desc: If open, a short visit fits a medina morning.

3.title: Façade only
3.desc: If closed, still worth seeing from the street.

food.title: Nearby food
food.p1: Medina and harbour options a short walk away.
food.p2: No permanent restaurant inside the palace.

1.title: Opening
1.desc: Hours vary; ask at your hotel or the tourist office.

2.title: Dress
2.desc: Modest clothing is appreciated for cultural venues.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: Medina + palace + ramparts is a natural half-day.

q1.question: Is it always open?
q1.answer: No. Opening depends on events and local schedule.

q2.question: Ticket needed?
q2.answer: Sometimes for events; ask on site.

q4.question: Worth it if closed?
q4.answer: The exterior still adds to a medina walk.

q5.question: Linked to the arts festival?
q5.answer: Cultural programmes often increase around the summer Moussem.
